description: Create a reusable benchmark with a mandatory scoring judge. scenario_type='enrichment' needs schema_id and entity_data (the entity to enrich, as enrich_entity takes it — refused when it carries no value; never put it in description); 'sample_generation' needs sample_request; 'schema_generation' needs entity_samples (1..20 samples of one entity type). Enrichment and schema generation need a verified gold reference via set_benchmark_reference before running. Sample generation is rubric-scored and takes no reference. Requires owner and a plan with benchmarks; creating the scenario does not run the models. Returns the scenario and link. Next call run_benchmark when its reference requirements are satisfied. See enricher://docs/model-benchmark.

attachment_ids.description: Attachment UUIDs included in every run.
attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids

description.description: Free-text note shown in the Benchmarks tab; no model ever reads it. The entity to enrich goes in entity_data, never here.
description.title: Description

enable_web_search.description: sample_generation: ground values with the model's web search.
enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search

entity_data.description: Enrichment (required there): the fixed entity input every model enriches — the same JSON enrich_entity takes. Read get_schema.input_contract first: identifying fields, preserve paths and keys for supplied array items. Refused when it carries no value.
entity_data.title: Entity Data

entity_samples.description: schema_generation: the 1..20 fixed input samples (JSON objects of one entity type) every model converts to a schema. Several samples let the scoring read evidence the reference cannot state alone (nullable, types, identity).
entity_samples.title: Entity Samples

generate_semantic_ids.description: schema_generation: add semantic_id properties to keyed objects.
generate_semantic_ids.title: Generate Semantic Ids

language.description: sample_generation: output language for names + values.
language.title: Language

repetitions.description: Run each model N times per run; keeps mean + consistency spread.
repetitions.title: Repetitions

sample_request.description: sample_generation: the free-text sample request every model answers — the kind of entity, what the sample must contain, any budget or structural preference (same contract as generate_sample's request).
sample_request.title: Sample Request

schema_id.description: UUID of the saved schema to enrich against (enrichment only, required there).
schema_id.title: Schema Id

scoring_judge_model_key.description: LLM judge composite key used to score results (required).
scoring_judge_model_key.title: Scoring Judge Model Key

strategy.description: Enrichment: pinned strategy (no 'auto'): single_pass | expert_domains | multi_expertise
strategy.title: Strategy

typical_object.description: sample_generation: a specific instance to model (e.g. 'Serena Williams').
typical_object.title: Typical Object
